para.text: Make a copy of the RmaMf6Completed.gpt model and save it as RmaVoronoiPrt.gpt. You will find it under the PEST examples. Examples are saved in the "C:\Users\Public\Documents\ModelMuse Examples" folder.
If desired, PEST can be turned off by selecting "Model|PEST Properties..." and changing the PEST Status to "Inactive."
To add a Particle Transport (PRT) model, open the

dialog box and set the number of PRT models to 1. (MODFLOW 6 allows there to be multiple PRT models in the same simulation.) When you increase the number of PRT models, a pane for any new PRT models will be created along with one for a Particle Release Point (PRP) package in each model. (In addition to multiple PRT models in a simulation, MODFLOW 6 also allows multiple PRP packages in a PRT model.)

image.caption: Screen capture of the Particle Transport pane in the MODFLOW Packages and Programs dialog box just after setting the number of PRT models to 1.
